verdict.rationale: There is no vendor documentation committing to prompt, specific incident disclosure with actionable remediation steps, and the only evidence available is community commentary describing an actual incident where Vercel's disclosure was called vague, lacking specifics on compromised systems, and offering only generic advice—falling short of the story's bar. Since no vendor-tier claim exists to contrast against, this cannot be scored as 'disputed' (which requires two tiers), so it is judged as unproven.
